English: Lookout Mound
A simple earthen mound, hastily raised to give scouts a vantage point over the surrounding lands. Useful for early warning against raiders and wild beasts.
Raised Watchstand
A crude wooden scaffold atop the mound, allowing sentries to keep watch for approaching threats. Slightly improves population safety and response time.
Signal Fire Ring
A circle of stone and earth for signal fires, allowing for rapid communication between scouts and the main camp. Enhances population and supply, and strengthens clan unity.
Hilltop Perch
A semi-permanent wooden platform built on a high rise, providing scouts with panoramic views and a secure place to rest and relay messages.
Alert Tower
A tall wooden tower, expertly constructed with watch platforms and signal beacons. Enables swift warnings and improves supply and population limits.
Messengers Hut
A dedicated hut for messengers and runners, equipped with supplies and swift horses. Greatly increases communication efficiency across the clan.
Scout Outpost
A fortified outpost for elite scouts, featuring watch animals and armories. Further enhances supply and rapid response to threats.
Falconers Pavilion
A grand tented pavilion for falconers and their birds, enabling rapid long-distance scouting and messenger relay. Greatly improves supply and clan unity.
Riders Lookout
A multi-storey wooden tower with stables for the fastest horses, serving as a base for the swiftest riders and elite scouts. Dramatically increases supply and population multipliers.
Grand Watch Network
A legendary network of towers, pavilions, and relay stations spanning the land. Guarantees unmatched early warning, clan unity, and logistical supremacy for the horde.
